name: Peng Gao
title: Assistant Professor
department: Computer Science; N.C. Plant Sciences Initiative
researchAreas: Vision foundation models for multi-robot perception
fitReason: Current CoRob work deploys vision foundation models for coordinated robot perception, offering a concrete CS project area in model integration, uncertainty and communication-aware autonomy.

physicalEvidence.summary: July 2026 CERPE tests three physical Agilex Limo Pro robots in 13 indoor scenarios. Quantitative pose evaluation uses 130 sampled keyframes and 382 image pairs with motion-capture ground truth. A separate online 2–3 robot integration test runs perception on a laptop RTX 4080, with 438/780 ms updates for two/three robots and a 50 Hz low-level controller. Current CoRob student authors are verified.

shortVisit.summary: The live Join page invites motivated students to email about concrete technical contributions and prioritizes hands-on robot experience. It does not explicitly establish an external-master’s visitor or short internship pathway, so no short-visit points are assigned.

scoreReasons.fit: Strong foundation-model perception and collaborative autonomy, somewhat less manipulation/policy-centric.
scoreReasons.physical: Detailed named hardware, current group student authors and explicit online controller integration.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: General student inquiry instructions do not verify external short-visit eligibility.
scoreReasons.freshness: July 2026 physical deployment paper and current official/lab records.
